title: Optimize compaction candidate allocation
constraints: Preserve compaction fan-in and candidate ordering
rationale: Compaction always selects four SSTables but allocated a Vec for candidates and another Vec for old candidate IDs.
steps: Return fixed-size candidate storage instead of heap-allocating a Vec
Use fixed candidate IDs when retaining live SSTables after compaction
Run storage fusion tests and cargo check
expected_impact: Reduces small heap allocations in the background compaction path while keeping the same four-SSTable fan-in behavior.
